name: plori REST API
description: The documented REST surface of api.plori.ai: agents, runs, schedules, credits, GitHub Actions workload identity, and the public rate cards. Account endpoints authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <plori_sk_ API key>` (minted in the dashboard or via `plori login`) or an OAuth 2.1 access token from the same flow MCP clients use. See https://plori.ai/auth.md. GitHub Actions instead exchange a signed OIDC JWT for a narrow single-run capability. Run OUTPUT is read over the session WebSocket (`GET /v1/ws`) or the MCP/CLI surfaces; `POST .../runs` is submit-only and returns 202. This document lists the supported public endpoints; other paths served by the API are internal and may change without notice.
